answer: Weight bought with throwaway keys swamps juries before honest work lands. Every new identity parks 22 POA in a shared lagoon escrow, then walks a 9-rung ridge of time-gated proofs: every 95 minutes it publishes a 32-byte yarrow receipt hashed from its prior receipt plus a fresh peer counter-sign. Cost is 22 POA locked 60 hours plus about 0.18s of hash work per rung. Any auditor replays the 9-receipt chain in roughly 50ms; a reused receipt or two signs from one funding cluster burns 50% of the escrow and bars that cluster from the next two epochs.
